questions.stem: A survey about a policy receives 160 voluntary responses on an online forum used by some residents of a town. Which conclusion is most reasonable?

options.A: The responses perfectly represent all residents of a town.
options.B: The responses describe the volunteers but may not represent the full population.
options.C: The survey proves the policy causes participation.
options.D: A larger number of volunteer responses automatically removes selection bias.

questions.explanation: B is correct. Voluntary response can systematically differ from the full population.

questions.stem: A simple random sample of 170 customers of a market is surveyed about a policy. Which conclusion is most reasonable?

options.A: The results prove how every person in the country feels.
options.B: The survey establishes that the policy causes the reported opinions.
options.C: The results may be generalized to customers of a market, subject to sampling variability.
options.D: No conclusion about the sampled population is possible.

questions.explanation: C is correct. A random sample supports generalization to the population from which it was drawn, with uncertainty.
